eligibility_prerecorded.note: only if ALL hold may a candidate enter N2 algorithm evaluation

family_definitions.visual_content_family: sample diversity: source/asset, scene type, target object & material, composition & target ratio, camera motion, occlusion, person/pot/hand interference, scene switches, action type or none
family_definitions.algorithm_evidence_family: method chain: FEATURE_LOCAL / FEATURE_LOCAL_ENSEMBLE / SEMANTIC_DENSE_LK / GLOBAL_CAMERA
rules: 3 algorithms on 1 visual sample = 1 visual family
V24 & GFTT same FEATURE_LOCAL chain, not independent
same canonical asset or near-dup clip != multiple families
same video same scene pairs = 1 family
different media_id alone insufficient for different family
need different source/near-dup cluster + real visual difference
2543 is family anchor; do not force candidates in/out
